SELECT capc.collection_id, capc.times, capc.rental_back_date, capc.cash_date, capc.collection_date, capc.remittance_date, capc.report_date, capc.due_amount, ( SELECT c1.rental_back_date FROM ct_abs_product_collection c1 WHERE c1.product_id = capc.product_id AND c1.times = capc.times - 1 ) AS before_rental_back_date FROM ct_abs_product_collection capc WHERE capc.collection_number is null and capc.data_class='NORMAL'
and capc.product_id = #{productId}

SELECT capc.collection_id, capc.times, capc.rental_back_date, capc.cash_date, capc.collection_date, capc.remittance_date, capc.report_date, capc.due_amount, ( SELECT c1.rental_back_date FROM ct_abs_product_collection c1 WHERE c1.product_id = capc.product_id AND c1.times = capc.times - 1 ) AS before_rental_back_date FROM ct_abs_product_collection capc WHERE capc.remittance_number = '' and capc.collection_status = 'CONFIRM' and capc.data_class='NORMAL'
and capc.product_id = #{productId}

SELECT capc.collection_id as collectionId, capc.imputation_account_id as imputationAccountId, capc.collection_organization_id as collectionOrganizationId, capc.times, capc.rental_back_date as rentalBackDate, capc.cash_date as cashDate, capc.collection_date as collectionDate, capc.remittance_date as remittanceDate, capc.report_date as reportDate, capc.due_amount as dueAmount, capc.principal, capc.interest, capc.collection_number as collectionNumber, capc.collection_apply_date as collectionApplyDate, capc.collection_status as collectionStatus, capc.collection_account_id as collectionAccountId, ( SELECT c1.rental_back_date FROM ct_abs_product_collection c1 WHERE c1.product_id = capc.product_id AND c1.times = capc.times - 1 ) AS beforeRentalBackDate, ( SELECT hbm.bp_name FROM ct_abs_product_organization po, hls_bp_master hbm WHERE capc.collection_organization_id = po.organization_id AND po.bp_id = hbm.bp_id ) AS bpName, ( SELECT ba.bank_account_num FROM ct_abs_product_organization po, hls_bp_master_bank_account ba WHERE capc.collection_organization_id = po.organization_id AND ba.bank_account_id = po.bank_account_id ) AS bankAccountNum, ( SELECT ba.bank_account_name FROM ct_abs_product_organization po, hls_bp_master_bank_account ba WHERE capc.collection_organization_id = po.organization_id AND ba.bank_account_id = po.bank_account_id ) AS bankAccountName, ( SELECT ba.bank_branch_name FROM ct_abs_product_organization po, hls_bp_master_bank_account ba WHERE capc.collection_organization_id = po.organization_id AND ba.bank_account_id = po.bank_account_id ) AS bankName, ( SELECT cba.bank_account_name FROM csh_bank_account cba WHERE capc.collection_account_id = cba.bank_account_id) AS collectionAccountName, ( SELECT cba.bank_account_num FROM csh_bank_account cba WHERE capc.collection_account_id = cba.bank_account_id) AS collectionAccountNumber, ( SELECT cba.bank_account_name FROM csh_bank_account cba WHERE capc.imputation_account_id = cba.bank_account_id) AS imputationAccountName, ( SELECT cba.bank_account_num FROM csh_bank_account cba WHERE capc.imputation_account_id = cba.bank_account_id) AS imputationAccountNumber FROM ct_abs_product_collection capc WHERE capc.collection_id = #{collectionId}

SELECT capc.collection_id, capc.product_id, capc.times, capc.collection_amount, capc.collection_status, capc.remittance_amount, capc.remittance_status, capc.remittance_date, capc.cash_date, capc.cash_status, capc.cash_amount, cad.product_short_name, cad.product_number, cad.business_type, cad.product_name, nvl(pcd.plan_cash_principal_sum,0) plan_cash_principal_sum, nvl(pcd.plan_cash_interest_sum,0) plan_cash_interest_sum, nvl(pcd.cash_principal_sum,0) cash_principal_sum, nvl(pcd.cash_interest_sum,0) cash_interest_sum FROM ct_abs_product_collection capc JOIN ct_abs_product cad ON cad.product_id=capc.product_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT cd.collection_id, SUM(cd.plan_cash_principal) plan_cash_principal_sum, SUM(cd.plan_cash_interest) plan_cash_interest_sum, SUM(cd.cash_principal) cash_principal_sum, SUM(cd.cash_interest) cash_interest_sum FROM ct_abs_product_cash_detail cd GROUP BY cd.collection_id ) pcd ON pcd.collection_id=capc.collection_id WHERE capc.collection_id = #{collectionId}

SELECT capc.collection_id as collectionId, capc.remittance_organization_id as remittanceOrganizationId, capc.times, capc.rental_back_date as rentalBackDate, capc.cash_date as cashDate, capc.collection_date as collectionDate, capc.remittance_date as remittanceDate, capc.report_date as reportDate, capc.due_amount as dueAmount, capc.principal, capc.interest, capc.remittance_number as remittanceNumber, capc.remittance_apply_date as remittanceApplyDate, capc.remittance_status as remittanceStatus, ( SELECT c1.rental_back_date FROM ct_abs_product_collection c1 WHERE c1.product_id = capc.product_id AND c1.times = capc.times - 1 ) AS beforeRentalBackDate, ( SELECT hbm.bp_name FROM ct_abs_product_organization po, hls_bp_master hbm WHERE capc.remittance_organization_id = po.organization_id AND po.bp_id = hbm.bp_id ) AS bpName, ( SELECT ba.bank_account_num FROM ct_abs_product_organization po, hls_bp_master_bank_account ba WHERE capc.remittance_organization_id = po.organization_id AND ba.bank_account_id = po.bank_account_id ) AS bankAccountNum, ( SELECT ba.bank_account_name FROM ct_abs_product_organization po, hls_bp_master_bank_account ba WHERE capc.remittance_organization_id = po.organization_id AND ba.bank_account_id = po.bank_account_id ) AS bankAccountName, ( SELECT ba.bank_branch_name FROM ct_abs_product_organization po, hls_bp_master_bank_account ba WHERE capc.remittance_organization_id = po.organization_id AND ba.bank_account_id = po.bank_account_id ) AS bankName FROM ct_abs_product_collection capc WHERE capc.collection_id = #{collectionId}

SELECT collection_number, remittance_number FROM ct_abs_product_collection WHERE product_id IN ( SELECT product_id FROM ct_abs_product WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND data_class = 'NORMAL' )
and collection_number != ''
and remittance_number != ''

SELECT nvl(capc.service_fee,0)+ nvl(hosting_fee,0)+ nvl(management_fee,0)+ nvl(underwriting_fee,0)+ nvl(rating_fee,0)+ nvl(evaluation_fee,0)+ nvl(listing_fee,0)+ nvl(lawyer_fee,0)+ ifnull (accountant_fee,0)+ nvl(other_fee,0)+nvl(tax_fee,0) fee_sum FROM ct_abs_product_collection capc WHERE capc.collection_id=#{collectionId}

select v.times,v.cash_date,v.income_fee,v.collection_id from(select (case when #{cfItem} = 910 then OTHER_FEE when #{cfItem} = 909 then ACCOUNTANT_FEE when #{cfItem} = 908 then LISTING_FEE when #{cfItem} = 907 then EVALUATION_FEE when #{cfItem} = 906 then RATING_FEE when #{cfItem} = 905 then LAWYER_FEE when #{cfItem} = 904 then UNDERWRITING_FEE when #{cfItem} = 903 then MANAGEMENT_FEE when #{cfItem} = 902 then HOSTING_FEE when #{cfItem} = 901 then SERVICE_FEE end) income_fee, t.* from CT_ABS_PRODUCT_COLLECTION t where PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}) v where v.income_fee is not null order by v.times desc
mapper.update: UPDATE CT_ABS_PRODUCT_COLLECTION CAPC SET CAPC.COLLECTION_STATUS='BLOCK', CAPC.REMITTANCE_STATUS='BLOCK' WHERE CAPC.RENTAL_BACK_DATE> ( SELECT MIN(CAPB.BUYBACK_DATE) BUYBACK_DATE FROM CT_ABS_PRODUCT_BUYBACK CAPB WHERE CAPB.PRODUCT_ID=CAPC.PRODUCT_ID) AND CAPC.COLLECTION_STATUS='NEW' AND CAPC.REMITTANCE_STATUS='NEW' AND CAPC.PRODUCT_ID=#{productId}
mapper.select: SELECT CAPC.* FROM CT_ABS_PRODUCT_COLLECTION CAPC WHERE CAPC.DATA_CLASS='NORMAL' AND CAPC.TIMES= ( SELECT MAX(PC.TIMES) FROM CT_ABS_PRODUCT_COLLECTION PC WHERE PC.CONFIRM_FLAG='Y') AND CAPC.PRODUCT_ID=#{productId}
mapper.update: UPDATE CT_ABS_PRODUCT_COLLECTION CAPC SET CAPC.CONFIRM_FLAG='Y' WHERE CAPC.DATA_CLASS='TEMP' AND CAPC.PRODUCT_ID=#{productId} AND CAPC.TIMES=#{times}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM CT_ABS_PRODUCT_COLLECTION CAPC WHERE CAPC.DATA_CLASS='NORMAL' AND ( nvl(CAPC.COLLECTION_STATUS,'NEW')!='CONFIRM' OR nvl(CAPC.REMITTANCE_STATUS,'NEW')!='CONFIRM' OR nvl(CAPC.CASH_STATUS,'NEW')!='CONFIRM') AND CAPC.PRODUCT_ID=#{productId}
mapper.delete: delete from ct_abs_product_collection where confirm_flag='N' and product_id = #{productId} and data_class=#{dataClass}
